timestep_source: Local robot/bench integration resolution; 0.5 ms, finer than the upstream 2 ms scenes. Sensor solver settings are loaded separately from its own repository.
friction_source: Existing task object friction; sensor contact parameters come from each distinct source model (TACTO/FOTS MuJoCo/GelSight), never this task value.
control_source: Existing Panda teleoperation IK/joint-PD runner; task defaults use pinned Menagerie (cube/feeding/chip) or robosuite (cable/peg) gripper servos. Not a DIGIT or GelSight hardware specification.
